rows.label: Personal income tax: state income tax in three withholding steps (tekjuskattur) [national]
rows.value: 31.49%, 37.99% and 46.29% of monthly pay in 2026, including the average municipal tax of 14.94%; personal tax credit ISK 72,492 a month. Paid by residents and non-residents with Icelandic income (withheld by employers). Lög nr. 90/2003 um tekjuskatt; lög nr. 45/1987 um staðgreiðslu opinberra gjalda.

source.title: Skatturinn: Helstu tölur og prósentur 2026 (staðgreiðsla)

rows.label: Municipal income tax (útsvar) [municipal]
rows.value: 12.44% to 14.97% by municipality; 14.94% average used in withholding. Paid by residents (and non-residents working in Iceland). Lög nr. 4/1995 um tekjustofna sveitarfélaga.
rows.note: Checklist item A3; detailed table: municipal-tax

source.title: Skatturinn: Staðgreiðsla 2026 (Hlutföll og fjárhæðir)

rows.label: Capital gains tax (capital income tax) (fjármagnstekjuskattur) [national]
rows.value: 22%; ISK 300,000 annual allowance per person (ISK 600,000 for couples) on interest and on dividends and gains from listed shares. Paid by individuals with interest, dividends, gains or rental income. Lög nr. 90/2003 um tekjuskatt; lög nr. 94/1996 um staðgreiðslu skatts á fjármagnstekjur.
rows.note: Checklist item A5; detailed table: capital-income-withholding

source.title: Skatturinn: Helstu tölur og prósentur 2026 (fjármagnstekjuskattur)

rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties (staðgreiðsla fjármagnstekjuskatts) [national]
rows.value: residents 22%; non-resident companies 20% on dividends (refundable to EEA companies), 12% on interest, 20% on royalties; non-resident individuals 34.94% on royalties. Paid by recipients (withheld by the payer). Lög nr. 90/2003 um tekjuskatt, art. 3 and 70.
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: capital-income-withholding

source.title: Skatturinn (Iceland Revenue and Customs): Dividends (non-resident companies)

rows.label: Rental income and pension income (leigutekjur; lífeyrisgreiðslur) [national]
rows.value: residential letting of at most two properties: 22% on 75% of the rent, without deductions; pensions taxed like wages with the personal tax credit. Paid by landlords; pensioners. Lög nr. 90/2003 um tekjuskatt.
rows.note: Checklist item A7; detailed table: capital-income-withholding

source.title: Skatturinn: Helstu tölur og prósentur 2026 (fjármagnstekjuskattur)

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (takmörkuð skattskylda) [national]
rows.value: stays of less than 183 days in 12 months: ordinary withholding with the personal credit in proportion to the stay; directors' fees and freelance services 34.94%. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). Lög nr. 90/2003 um tekjuskatt, art. 3.
rows.note: Checklist item A8; detailed table: non-resident

source.title: Skatturinn (Iceland Revenue and Customs): Limited tax liability

rows.label: Social security contributions: mandatory pension fund contributions (iðgjald í lífeyrissjóð) [national]
rows.value: statutory minimum 15.5% of pay. Paid by employees (4%) and employers (11.5%) under collective agreements. Lög nr. 129/1997 um skyldutryggingu lífeyrisréttinda.

rows.value: 6.35% in 2026 (general 4.90%, unemployment insurance 1.35%, Wage Guarantee Fund 0.05%, market levy 0.05%). Paid by employers, on total pay (and the self-employed on calculated remuneration). Lög nr. 113/1990 um tryggingagjald.
rows.note: Checklist item B2; detailed table: social-employer

source.title: Skatturinn: Tryggingagjald

rows.label: Self-employed contributions: tryggingagjald and pension on calculated remuneration (reiknað endurgjald) [national]
rows.value: 6.35% tryggingagjald and the 15.5% minimum pension contribution on a calculated wage no lower than the tax authority's minimum for the category. Paid by self-employed persons and working controlling shareholders. Lög nr. 90/2003, art. 58; reglur ríkisskattstjóra um reiknað endurgjald 2026.

rows.value: 34.94% for individuals (20% state + 14.94% municipal), 20% for companies, unless an exemption is approved on form RSK 5.42. Paid by Icelandic payers of non-resident contractors. Lög nr. 90/2003 um tekjuskatt, art. 3(3).

rows.value: 20% (limited companies, cooperatives); 37.6% (partnerships taxed separately, estates). Paid by limited companies and other legal persons. Lög nr. 90/2003 um tekjuskatt, art. 71.

rows.label: Value added tax (VAT) (virðisaukaskattur) [national]

rows.value: 5.5% of all wages; special financial activities tax of 6% on taxable income above ISK 1,000 million. Paid by financial firms, securities firms and insurers. Lög nr. 165/2011 um fjársýsluskatt.

rows.value: None: 'Net wealth tax has been abolished'. Paid by no one. Skatturinn, Non-resident.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Iceland
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance
rows.source_title: Skatturinn: Helstu tölur og prósentur 2026 (erfðafjárskattur)
rows.label: Inheritance tax (erfðafjárskattur) [national]
rows.value: 10% of the estate's tax base above ISK 6,789,790 (2026). Paid by heirs (spouses and cohabitants under a will pay none). Lög nr. 14/2004 um erfðafjárskatt.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Iceland
rows.note: Checklist item F1; detailed table: vehicle-taxes
rows.source_title: Skatturinn: Bifreiðagjald
rows.label: Motor vehicle tax and the kilometre fee (bifreiðagjald; kílómetragjald) [national]
rows.value: ISK 21,260 per half-year plus a CO2 supplement (heavier vehicles ISK 73,795 base, at most ISK 115,450); kilometre fee ISK 6.95 per km for cars up to 3.5 t. Paid by owners of registered vehicles. Lög nr. 39/1988 um bifreiðagjald; lög nr. 100/2025 um kílómetragjald.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Iceland
rows.note: Checklist item F2
rows.source_title: Skatturinn: Umhverfis- og auðlindaskattar (kolefnisgjald, skattur af heitu vatni)
rows.label: Carbon tax on liquid fossil fuels (kolefnisgjald) [national]
rows.value: levied per litre under Act no. 129/2009 (rate not read: the law text could not be opened). Paid by importers and producers of petrol, diesel, aviation fuel and fuel oil. Lög nr. 129/2009 um umhverfis- og auðlindaskatta.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Iceland
rows.note: Checklist item F3; detailed table: tourist-tax
rows.source_title: Skatturinn (Iceland Revenue and Customs): Lodging tax
rows.label: Accommodation tax (lodging tax) and cruise infrastructure fee (gistináttaskattur; innviðagjald) [national]
rows.value: ISK 800 per unit per night (hotels, guesthouses), ISK 400 (campsites, domestic cruises); ISK 2,500 per passenger per day for international cruise ships. Paid by accommodation providers and cruise operators (passed on to guests). Lög nr. 87/2011 um gistináttaskatt og innviðagjald.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Iceland
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs
rows.source_title: Skatturinn: Almennt um sendingar (parcels and consignments)
rows.label: Customs duties, import VAT and travel allowances (tollar og aðflutningsgjöld) [national]
rows.value: all goods dutiable whatever their value (no de minimis); duties by tariff line on the CIF value; import VAT 24% or 11%. Paid by importers and travellers. Tollalög nr. 88/2005.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Iceland
rows.note: Checklist item H2
rows.source_title: Skatturinn: Helstu tölur og prósentur 2026 (útvarpsgjald, gjald í framkvæmdasjóð aldraðra)
rows.label: Broadcasting fee (RÚV) and the Elderly Construction Fund fee (útvarpsgjald; gjald í framkvæmdasjóð aldraðra) [national]
rows.value: ISK 22,200 (broadcasting fee) and ISK 14,614 (Elderly Construction Fund) in the 2026 assessment. Paid by individuals with income above ISK 2,617,618 and legal persons, collected in the tax assessment. Lög nr. 23/2013 um Ríkisútvarpið; lög nr. 125/1999 um málefni aldraðra.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Iceland
rows.note: Checklist item H3; detailed table: freelancers
rows.source_title: Skatturinn: Erlendir sérfræðingar
rows.label: Foreign experts: 25% of wages tax-exempt for three years (expat regime) (erlendir sérfræðingar) [national]
rows.value: 25% of wages exempt from income tax for the first three years. Paid by approved foreign experts. Lög nr. 90/2003 um tekjuskatt, art. 30.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Iceland
rows.note: Checklist item A2
rows.source_title: Stjórnarráð Íslands (Fjármála- og efnahagsráðuneytið): Skattar og þjónustugjöld vegna atvinnurekstrar
rows.label: Surcharge on income tax: none [national]
rows.value: None: the direct taxes are income tax, capital income tax, municipal income tax (útsvar), social security tax, the Elderly Construction Fund fee, the broadcasting fee, the agricultural levy and the universal service levy; there is no surcharge on income tax. Paid by no one. Fjármála- og efnahagsráðuneytið, Skattar og þjónustugjöld vegna atvinnurekstrar.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Iceland
rows.note: Checklist item A4
rows.source_title: Stjórnarráð Íslands (Dómsmálaráðuneytið): Sóknargjöld hækkuð og aukið fé til viðhalds á friðuðum kirkjum, 10. september 2026
rows.label: Religious organisation fee: parish fee financed by the state budget (sóknargjald) [national]
rows.value: ISK 1,221 per person a month in 2026, paid to religious organisations from the state budget; the 2027 budget bill proposes ISK 1,270 (not enacted). Paid by the state budget. Lög um sóknargjöld (nr. 91/1987); fjárlög.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Iceland
rows.note: Checklist item F4
rows.source_title: Stjórnarráð Íslands (Fjármála- og efnahagsráðuneytið): Skattar og þjónustugjöld vegna atvinnurekstrar
rows.label: Departure or air passenger tax: none [national]
rows.value: None: no departure or air passenger tax is among the taxes and charges listed by the Ministry of Finance for individuals and businesses, which include the lodging tax (gistináttaskattur). Paid by no one. Fjármála- og efnahagsráðuneytið, Skattar og þjónustugjöld vegna atvinnurekstrar and Skattar og þjónustugjöld einstaklinga.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Iceland
rows.note: Checklist item H1
rows.source_title: Stjórnarráð Íslands (Fjármála- og efnahagsráðuneytið): Skattar og þjónustugjöld einstaklinga – Stimpilgjald
rows.label: Stamp duty on documents transferring real property and ships (stimpilgjald) [national]
rows.value: 0.8% of the price or value if the acquirer is an individual and 1.6% if a legal person, on documents transferring real property and ships over 5 gross tonnes; half rate for a first home purchase and forced sales; no duty on name changes after mergers or conversions. Paid by acquirers. Lög um stimpilgjald nr. 138/2013.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Iceland
rows.note: Checklist item H1
rows.source_title: Stjórnarráð Íslands (Fjármála- og efnahagsráðuneytið): Aðrir skattar og gjöld (lög nr. 88/1991, um aukatekjur ríkissjóðs)
rows.label: Administrative fees for state documents and certificates (aukatekjur ríkissjóðs) [national]
rows.value: Fixed fees, set like a tariff, for documents and certificates issued by state bodies (court procedure, registration of title, trade licences, firearms, company law). Paid by applicants. Lög nr. 88/1991, um aukatekjur ríkissjóðs.
